description: Use this when the user asks whether they must or may register for UAE VAT, about the AED 375,000 or 187,500 thresholds, or by when they must register. Says whether a UAE business must register for VAT (taxable supplies and imports over AED 375,000 in the past 12 months, or expected to go over it in the next 30 days), may register voluntarily (supplies or taxable expenses over AED 187,500) or does not need to yet, with both tests shown. When registration is mandatory it gives the 30-day registration deadline; pass required_since (the day the threshold was crossed) to get the date and days left. Amounts are in AED; taxable supplies include standard- and zero-rated supplies and imports, not exempt ones. Do not use it for corporate tax registration (ct_registration_deadline).

expected_taxable_supplies_next_30_days.description: Taxable supplies and imports expected in the next 30 days alone, AED.

required_since.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the day the AED 375,000 threshold was crossed (or first expected to be), for the 30-day deadline.

taxable_expenses_last_12_months.description: Taxable expenses over the past 12 months, AED (voluntary test).

taxable_supplies_last_12_months.description: Taxable supplies and imports over the past 12 months, AED.

uae_resident.description: Default true. Non-residents making taxable supplies in the UAE must register at any amount.

name: check_vat_registration
title: Check UAE VAT registration
